House Plants / 01

Asparagus Fern

Your quick care reference

Water when

The top 1 inch of soil feels dry.

Check about 2.5 cm deep with your finger. Keep some moisture below the surface; avoid letting the whole pot dry out.

How to water

Water slowly over the whole soil surface until water drains from the bottom. Let it drain fully, then empty the saucer or outer pot.

Fertilizer

Balanced liquid houseplant fertilizer, ½ strength, monthly during spring and summer growth.

Dilute using the product’s label rate. Skip feeding during slow winter growth.

Support / moss pole

None normally needed. Let its feathery stems arch and spread naturally.

Repot / upsize when

  • Roots densely fill or start distorting the pot.
  • The soil dries much faster after a thorough watering.
  • A root check shows crowded roots with little loose soil.

Next pot: about 1–2 inches (2.5–5 cm) wider, with drainage holes. Spring is the best time.

Check the soil, not the calendar.
Winter usually means longer gaps between watering.
